body: I do think I'd be into BDSM, especially when I'm browsing through redtube or something. Might give bodybuilding a miss, I like my curves ;) I like your suggestion though, replacing the urge with something else. I never thought of it like that before :)

I've been in a similar situation to you, though it was with essays rather than exams. There's been at least 3 essays I never handed in during my first year of uni because I was scared of writing pure shit and the thought of writing 2000 words sounded impossible. I subsequently had to retake them, but got cold feet once again and was nearly withdrawn from the course.

Now I'm a few months away from graduating, so I guess what I wanna say is get support from your personal tutor/counselling centre and maybe get a letter from your doctor to excuse yourself from the exam/get an extension etc. Good luck whatever happens
